description:
About the company
 Our client is a fast-growing software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Lead hands-on implementation of software solutions for public sector customers, combining production coding with direct customer engagement and cross-team coordination. The role suits an early-career engineer who enjoys translating technical ideas for non-technical audiences.
 What you'll do
 - Serve as the primary implementation lead for government customers, onboarding their content into the platform.
 - Manage configuration and service orchestration securely within a regulated government cloud environment.
 - Build customer-requested features across front-end and backend, including UI changes, data tables and file handling.
 - Host customer meetings and walk senior stakeholders through AI concepts in accessible terms.
 - Balance your week across development work, customer engagement and internal coordination, with development taking the largest share.
 - Travel to customer sites in the Washington, DC area, with travel costs covered.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - 1 to 3 years of engineering experience.
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related STEM field.
 - Strong programming skills in Python and TypeScript, with comfort spending about half the time on focused coding.
 - Experience shipping LLM or agent-based systems in production.
 - Hands-on experience with a major cloud AI platform such as AWS, Azure or GCP.
 - Experience deploying software in government or regulated environments.
 - Clear communication and ease talking with customers.
 - Ability to work on-site five days a week.
 Bonus points
 - Experience in a fast-paced, zero-to-one environment.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 130,000 to 170,000 per year
 - Equity
 - Relocation support
 Location and work model
 - Los Altos, CA, United States
 - On-site, 5 days per week in office
 - Full-time
 - Travel to the DC area expected
